a.title: NVIDIA is investigating reports that CEO Jensen Huang was the target of Chinese spy efforts

b.lede: Nvidia's board has separated from Jensen Huang, its longtime co-founder, president, and CEO, after reports of two extramarital affairs - one with an alleged Chinese spy and one with an Nvidia executive who reported to Huang.
